_comment: Release settings read by tools/release/release.tscn. The version number comes from GitHub's release tags (alpha2.1, alpha2.2, ...); first_version is only used when the repo has no alpha tags yet; min_version (optional) is the lowest version to publish, for a jump like alpha3.0 (later releases go on from it: alpha3.1 ...). force_version rebuilds that exact version and replaces its uploaded files instead of picking the next one; clear it ( ) when the rebuild is done.
